# telnyx_ips (Data Source)

Lists ips, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ip`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_connection_id` (String) ID of the IP Connection to which this IP should be attached.
- `filter_ip_address` (String) IP adddress represented by this resource.
- `filter_port` (Number) Port to use when connecting to this IP.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `ips` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ips))

<a id="nestedatt--ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ips`

Read-Only:

- `connection_id` (String) ID of the IP Connection to which this IP should be attached.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the type of resource.
- `ip_address` (String) IP adddress represented by this resource.
- `port` (Number) Port to use when connecting to this IP.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.
